DSA1.title: Two Sum
DSA1.description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to target. Assume exactly one solution exists.

DSA2.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
DSA2.description: Given a string s, return the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

DSA3.title: Valid Parentheses
DSA3.description: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid (every bracket is closed by the same type, in the correct order).

DSA4.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
DSA4.description: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it is a valid binary search tree (BST): every node's left subtree contains only values less than the node, and the right subtree only values greater.

DSA5.title: Number of Connected Components
DSA5.description: Given n nodes labeled 0..n-1 and a list of undirected edges, return the number of connected components in the graph.

DSA6.title: Climbing Stairs
DSA6.description: You are climbing a staircase with n steps. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. In how many distinct ways can you reach the top?
